title: sida patens
intro: Sida patens, commonly known as the "white sensitive plant," is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Malvaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Sida patens include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to treat various skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
